Pedal_Profile_Desc_preset_standard: Compatible with all standard pedals and Bluetooth keyboards (PageUp, PageDown, Arrows, Space, Enter). Ideal for universal setups.
Pedal_Profile_Desc_preset_pageflip_drago: Configuration for the PageFlip Dragonfly 4-pedal controller. Recommended physical setting: REPEAT switch OFF and selector on Mode 3 (PageDown / PageUp) for the two main pedals. External auxiliary switches are configured for bookmark jumps or score start/end.
Pedal_Profile_Desc_preset_pageflip_firef: PageFlip Firefly and Butterfly 2-pedal controllers. Recommended physical setting: selector on Mode 3 (PageDown / PageUp) and REPEAT switch OFF to prevent unintentional double turns.
Pedal_Profile_Desc_preset_airturn_duo: AirTurn Bluetooth controllers with 2 silent switches. Recommended physical setting: Mode 3 (PageDown / PageUp) or Mode 2 (Left / Right arrows). Works with all devices via Bluetooth BLE.
Pedal_Profile_Desc_preset_airturn_quad: AirTurn 4-switch pedal controller. Recommended setting: Mode 3. Pedals 1 & 3 to turn pages, pedals 2 & 4 to navigate between score bookmarks or songs.
Pedal_Profile_Desc_preset_donner: Donner wireless dual pedal. Recommended physical setting: rear switch on Mode 1 (PageDown / PageUp) or Mode 2 (Horizontal arrows).
Pedal_Profile_Desc_preset_joyo: Joyo JSP-01 wireless pedal. Recommended setting: switch on Mode 1 (Arrows) or Mode 2 (PageUp/PageDown). Ensure continuous repeat is disabled.
Pedal_Profile_Desc_preset_harley_benton: Harley Benton PageTurn 2-switch pedal. Physical setting: selector on Mode 1 (Arrows) or Mode 2 (PageUp/PageDown).
Pedal_Profile_Desc_preset_irig_blueturn: Compact and backlit iRig BlueTurn pedal with 2 silent keys. Recommended setting: Mode 1 (PageUp / PageDown) or Mode 2 (Arrows).
Pedal_Profile_Desc_preset_coda_stomp: Ultra-rugged STOMP pedal in solid aluminum enclosure. Recommended hardware setting: mode selector on Mode 1 (PageUp / PageDown) for instant responsiveness on stage.
Pedal_Profile_Desc_preset_midi_controlle: MIDI pedals and master keyboards. Default assignments: Sustain pedal (CC 64) = Next page, Sostenuto pedal (CC 66) = Previous page, Soft pedal (CC 67) = Next bookmark.
